steps.content: The moment the mermaid falls, your mind also becomes a bit dazed.
Like a fairy tale, the mermaid's tail disappears, replaced by a pair of slender legs.
The lump on her back also falls off, turning into a man around her age.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ha... it's over... everything's over...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Macchiato... Kelvin... Miss Cabernet...
Thank you for all your effort, my dear guest...
Swish!
Several vines slither around the people on the ground, sweeping them aside. You fall to the ground, coughing continuously.
You look up to see someone sitting at the long banquet table.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who...?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Hmm? Weren't you... calling my name just now?
Thud! The person at the table props her cane on the ground and stands up gracefully.
Under the hazy aquarium lights, no one can ignore her elegant, fiery red hair.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: M..Miss Cabernet?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you here?!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: To enjoy the feast, of course.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: However... it seems that the feast isn't ready yet.
Cabernet walks up to you and sniffs your body scent intimately again.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah... you're really... very much to my liking.
A vine rises from her feet and slowly wraps around you. The Mania on it is the same kind that's emanating from the person in front of you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss Cabernet... you're... a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I'm glad you said that affirmatively.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Sorry for keeping this from you for so long... I just thought your reaction would be more authentic this way.
You become highly vigilant—only extremely powerful Sinners can summon the power to manipulate vines like that.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Your eyes are scaring me... are you too tired?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: No worries... no worries... It's all over now...
You're hit by the scent of grapes, and you black out.
Your consciousness slips away with the scent... Gradually, you lose all consciousness.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah... my ingredients are back.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: And my feast... is finally ready.
